claims.cytotoxic_mechanism: At 2.5 uM, this ATP1A1 (Na+/K+-ATPase) inhibitor most plausibly kills cells through a cardiac glycoside-like mechanism, i.e. Na+/K+-ATPase inhibition causing calcium overload and/or cationic amphiphilic lysosomal stress, rather than through its annotated ATPase target alone.
